title: Site factory order (all types)
description: One order = one brand, one domain, one concept, one type. schemaVersion 1.2 = the intake audit schema (1.0) + the SPEC 4.1 amendments (1.1) + the MASTER-PLAN 4.1 type fields (1.2): type, variant, locales, geo, audience, casinoMode, markets, generic operator, typeOptions (validated per type by types/<type>/schema/order-options.schema.json when the pack ships one), launch ticks policyUrlsVerified/audienceAssessmentSigned/affiliatePaidSearchChecked/providerPaidSearchChecked, ppc.primaryConversion. Invariants (disclaimer, RG tools, helplines, consent, SEO rules, budgets, WCAG, banned words, page set) are fixed by the engine and the type pack and are not configurable here. Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express (heroGame is a house slug, palette roles unique, topUpBelow < startingBalance, demos exist in the catalogue, registry number in the registry URL, dates not in the future, MX at launch, the ST 1.4 rejections) are checked by tools/validate-order.mjs.

orderId.description: Folder name under orders/. Stable for the life of the site.

audience.description: Set only from the signed audience assessment (D-23).

contactEndpoint.description: Empty: the contact form opens the mail client (mailto).

allOf.$comment: social-casino: typeOptions, structure/copy shapes, one en-GB locale, RG full, 18+, no personalisation (MASTER-PLAN 4.2).
social-casino with demos (pragmatic mode or demo-lobby): no Google Ads conversion id (ST 1.1, 1.4).
online-games child-likely: no personalisation, childDirected tag (MASTER-PLAN 4.2).
hotel-casino Mode A: a casino-free domain (ST 1.3).
launch-ready | live-pending | live forbid placeholders and require the launch evidence (SPEC 4.1).

date.description: ISO date; shown on the site as '25 September 2026'.

family.description: Banned by the brief: Inter, Poppins, Montserrat, Space Grotesk. Archivo and Radio Canada are taken by Opal Quest Lounge; the validator extends this list from the portfolio registry.

selfHosted.description: Subset woff2 in assets/fonts, font-display: swap, metric-matched fallbacks; never a Google Fonts request.

evidence.description: A command output, a URL, a screenshot path or a ticket id.

name.description: Unique across the whole portfolio; never a real slot or studio name.

engine.description: reel-slot, european-roulette and blackjack exist today (seven-systems, lapidary-wheel, brilliant-21 maths); the others are engine-library work orders.

spec.description: Engine parameters; shape depends on engine (see the conditional rules).

tags.description: Only features the game really has (build.mjs checks).

rtpNote.description: How the RTP is established: exact enumeration, 36/37, or Monte Carlo with hand count.

family.description: Concept family (~40 values; soft uniqueness rule, SPEC 15.4). Seeded from the brief concept families plus the registry usage.

placeholder.$comment: A bracketed placeholder such as "[Companies House number]".

world.description: The one idea from which palette, fonts, game names, currency, sound and motion are derived.

boldMove.description: The single bold decision for the whole site; everything else stays restrained.

rule.description: CAP 16.3.12: no characters, mascots, animals, faces, sweets, youth slang, memes or emoji.

antiReferences.description: What it must not look like (e.g. the brief's banned 2025 clichés, and the sibling sites).

siblings.description: Filled by order-to-config from the registry (same type only); stripped at export.

name.description: A name from the concept's world, not 'blue'.

themes.description: Two themes designed separately (light-dark()), never one inverted.

contrastChecked.description: Text/background pairs meet WCAG 2.2 AA in both themes.

numeric.description: Utility face for balances and tables; may be omitted when display covers it.

language.description: Language for questions, proposals and hand-over docs.

path.description: The client's free text, stored verbatim.

summary.description: AI summary in English of what the client asked for.

name.description: Must not contain any real casino, bookmaker or game-studio brand.

shortName.description: Web manifest short_name and the mobile dock.

wordmarkTag.description: Show the last word of the name as a tag in the wordmark (as 'Lounge' in Opal Quest Lounge).

accessConfirmed.description: Someone on the order can change the records.

domain.description: Apex domain. www always redirects to it (by host only, never by geo or user agent).

lastUpdated.description: site.config.json lastUpdated; never in the future.

path.description: Folder inside the repo when several sites share one; empty when the site has its own repo.

quote.description: The brief's own words (any language) that the value came from.

provenance.description: Where each value came from: extracted from the brief, asked of the operator, proposed by the AI, a factory default, or computed.

operator.description: Generic legal operator (D-11). Must match footer, Terms, Organization JSON-LD and the Google Ads advertiser verification. Never filled from guesses: unknown values are "[bracketed]" placeholders and become questions.

registeredIn.description: Jurisdiction of registration, e.g. "England and Wales".

heroGame.description: A house game that plays live in the first screen.

homeSections.description: Order of the home page. hero, lobby, how, safer and faq are mandatory; the rest are optional.

faq.description: Ids from the FAQ bank; each answer is rewritten in the site's voice.

buttons.description: Buttons say what will happen, with the amount: 'Spin for 24 Ticks'.

origin.description: Why this unit belongs to the world.

mode.description: house: only our own games, the only build that can be certified for Google Ads. pragmatic: Pragmatic Play demos plus at least two house tables; needs written consent.

demos.description: Slugs from src/data/pragmatic-games.json; appeal must be low or medium there.

games.description: Amendment 6: mode transitions pragmatic -> house are legal at any status.

disclosure.description: Shown on the landing page and beside every game when enabled.

sweepstakes.description: Redeemable coins move the order out of the type (ST 1.1); intake rejects true.

realMoneyLinks.description: Any link to real-money gambling is out of scope (ST 1.4).

scraped.description: Portals built by scraping Poki/CrazyGames iframes are rejected (ST 1.4).

primaryConversion.description: Owner placeholder: empty until the owner picks (Q11); --level launch refuses empty (D-42).
